scope: Round 14. SRS.txt 'system - Rag architechture - Chatbox': rebuild the Python RAG chat service (be/rag) so it never touches the database itself. Every action goes through the Node API and every API answer is checked; one RAG function per file; no LLM framework; the system prompt lives in its own structured file. Follows ecbot (be/rag/ecbot, reference only): api_client back-channel with an internal token, prompt loaded from a file, untrusted text neutralised, replies screened for prompt leaks and secrets. Builds on rounds 12-13 (feature_list_12.json, feature_list_13.json); every behaviour of /api/chat, /api/docs and the staff handoff stays.

source_requirements.text: system - Rag architechture - Chatbox. use ecbot to reference - only in rag system. rebuild rag system with api call to each action, prevent most sercurity risks also separate rag function to each files - easy to debug and expand. system prompt should stay in separate file. Req-1: all action now go through api call- check api return. Req-2: rag functions stay on 1 file 1. Req-3: do not force to build with framework. Req-4: system prompt should stay clear, structured. Tests: e2e, unit and integration tests written to the e2e folder. Changed files described in docs. All delete mean soft delete.

readings_to_confirm: Req-1 'all action go through api call': the Python service drops psycopg and its own JWT check. It reads and writes only through new Node routes under /api/rag (be/src/routes/rag.ts). The visitor's session cookie is forwarded so Node alone decides who the user is; service-only routes also need an X-Internal-Token header (RAG_INTERNAL_TOKEN, compared in constant time; unset -> 503), as ecbot's apps/ai does.

'check api return': one call_api function checks the status, the JSON and the shape the caller expects; any failure is an ApiError, never a silent wrong value. Callers decide: chat answers as a guest / without excerpts, uploads answer 502/503.
Req-2 'rag functions stay on 1 file 1': one public function per file in be/rag/functions/, the file named after the function. Private helpers used only by that function may sit in the same file.
Req-3: plain Flask + google-genai + requests stay; no LangChain/LlamaIndex or agent framework.

Req-4: be/rag/prompts/system.md is the system prompt, in tagged sections (role, rules, security, format); account, guest and excerpt blocks are separate template files in be/rag/prompts/. Text from documents or user names is put inside <untrusted> blocks with < and > neutralised.

Uploads keep the same Flask URL (/api/docs, Vite already proxies it); Flask chunks and embeds, then hands the rows to Node, which checks staff/admin through a new permission knowledge.manage (staff + admin, migration like chat.handle).
The Facebook /webhook route is left as it is (it never touched the database).

features.title: Node /api/rag routes for the RAG service
features.user_visible_behavior: None directly; the Python chat service gets its data from these routes instead of the database.
acceptance: GET /api/rag/me: signed-in user (cookie) -> {id, role, username, credit {balance, held, available}, bids (latest 5, own), lots (own open lots, 5)}; guests 401.
GET /api/rag/documents and DELETE /api/rag/documents/:id (soft delete, 404 when gone) need knowledge.manage (staff, admin); customers 403, guests 401.

POST /api/rag/documents needs knowledge.manage AND the internal token; body validated (title, filename, mimeType text/plain|text/markdown, content, 1..2000 chunks with text and a numeric embedding); stores document + chunks in one transaction; 201 {id, title, chunks}.
GET /api/rag/chunks needs only the internal token (no cookie): live chunks {title, text, embedding}; soft-deleted documents left out.
Wrong/missing internal token 401; RAG_INTERNAL_TOKEN unset 503.
evidence: 2026-11-18 npm test -w be: 83/84 files; the one failure each run was a Postgres deadlock (40P01) in resetDb in an unrelated file (search, commission) while another session ran project-gemini tests on the same db container; those files + sec.permissions + sch-1-5 + rag2 rerun 4/4 files passed

features.title: One function per file, and an API client that checks every answer
acceptance: be/rag/functions/ holds one public function per file: call_api, chunk_text, embed, rank, retrieve, session_user, check_messages, over_limit, handoff_or_error, read_upload, load_prompt, build_prompt, guard_reply.

call_api(method, path, cookie=None, internal=False, json=None, expect=dict|list) uses requests with a timeout, sends the cookie / X-Internal-Token only when asked, never follows redirects, and raises ApiError(status) on transport errors, non-2xx, non-JSON or a body of the wrong type.
chunk_text / embed / rank keep round 12's behaviour (same limits, retries and thresholds).
No psycopg import anywhere in be/rag; be/rag/rag.py removed; requirements.txt without psycopg.
verification: e2e/py/rag2_1_2_functions_test.py (call_api against a stub HTTP server, chunk/embed/rank unit tests moved from be/rag)
grep shows no psycopg in be/rag (ecbot excluded)

features.title: System prompt in its own structured file
features.user_visible_behavior: The bot follows the same rules as before (short plain answers, only the visitor's own data, log in hint for guests).
acceptance: be/rag/prompts/system.md: tagged sections <role>, <rules>, <security>, <format>; no Python string building of rules.

account.md, guest.md, excerpts.md templates; build_prompt fills them, puts document text and usernames inside <untrusted> with < > neutralised, and adds nothing when there is no account data or excerpt.
chat_cli.py uses the same prompt.

features.title: /api/chat rebuilt on the API
features.user_visible_behavior: Same chat box answers: grounded in uploaded documents, signed-in users see their own account, handoff to staff on limit / Gemini down.
acceptance: The visitor comes only from GET /api/rag/me with the forwarded cookie; 401 = guest; any other API failure = guest and logged.
Excerpts come from GET /api/rag/chunks (internal token) ranked in Python; failure = answer without excerpts.
Input checks, 30/min limit, handoff (sch-1.3) and sources unchanged; the body can never choose the user.
guard_reply: a reply that copies the prompt's section tags or contains a token/secret pattern (JWT, API key, internal token) is replaced by a safe fallback line.
verification: e2e/py/rag2_1_4_chat_test.py (API stubbed): ports chat_test, rag_chat_test, rag_user_test and sch_1_3 behaviour

features.title: /api/docs upload, list and delete through the API
features.user_visible_behavior: Staff/admin upload .txt/.md, list and soft delete documents at the same URLs as before.
acceptance: POST /api/docs: read_upload checks type, size (2 MB) and UTF-8 before any API call; chunk + embed; POST /api/rag/documents with the cookie and internal token; Node's status passed on (401/403/400), 502 on other API failures, 503 when embedding fails.
GET /api/docs and DELETE /api/docs/<id> forward to Node with the cookie and pass its answer on.
Old be/rag/*_test.py suites removed after their cases moved to e2e/py.

features.title: Full-path test: Flask -> real Node API -> Postgres
acceptance: A Python integration test starts the real Node API on auction_test, uploads a document as staff through Flask, asks /api/chat as a customer and gets the excerpt plus the customer's own account in the prompt (Gemini stubbed), then soft deletes it and the excerpt is gone.
docs/rag.md describes the new layout, the routes, the internal token and how to run it.
